releases.name: Toy Tactics
releases.summary:
Toy Tactics is an RTS where you can draw unit formations and command units based on minifigs to victory. 

Under the guidance of legendary generals, master the ability to draw configurations into the battlefield and send miniature legions to war against hordes of undead foes. Charge up your army with artifacts and destructive spells to give you the upper hand in battle and smash your foes in real-time. 

Think fast, deploy your units strategically, and lead them to victory!

releases.name: Train Plus Japan Drive Western Japan Trains! Rapid Service Edition
releases.summary: Drive real JR-West trains! An authentic railway driving game — Approved by West Japan Railway Company. Three fictional lines, every section drivable in both directions. A series-first scoring system and card-deck strategy turn precise driving into high scores. Over 40 hours of content.

releases.name: Dungeon Antiqua 2
releases.summary: Relive the golden age of dungeon RPGs with Dungeon Antiqua 2! A retro 2D dungeon crawler bursting with SNES nostalgia. Hack, slash, and survive relentless side-view encounters! With 10 jobs and endless skill combos, forge the ultimate party and conquer the depths—if you dare!

releases.name: Backyard Baseball
releases.summary: The timeless classic is leveling up with all-new game modes, new ways to play, brand-new features and more. It’s the game you love, reimagined for a whole new era. Get ready for Backyard Baseball like you've never experienced it before.

releases.name: Ready or Nowhere
releases.summary:
Can you survive the mission without making a single mistake?

Step into the heart of high-risk tactical operations in this intense first-person shooter where every move can mean the difference between success and failure. As an elite tactical operator, you are deployed into hostile environments overrun by dangerous terrorists, where innocent lives depend entirely on your actions. Every mission demands careful planning, accurate shooting, and the ability to stay calm under relentless pressure as you fight through fortified enemy positions and rescue hostages before it's too late.

Face unpredictable combat across detailed locations where every room, hallway, and corner could hide a deadly threat. Build your perfect loadout, customize your weapons and equipment, and adapt your tactics to every situation. Success isn't determined by speed alone—it belongs to those who think ahead, use every advantage, and complete every objective without leaving anyone behind.

releases.name: Shark Simulator: Ocean RPG Survival
releases.summary: Dive into the ruthless world beneath the waves in Shark Simulator: Ocean RPG Survival. In the endless blue of the ocean, only the strongest predator survives. Begin your journey as a hungry hunter and carve your path through a living underwater world filled with danger, prey, and powerful rivals. Every hunt makes you stronger, every battle pushes you closer to the top of the food chain. The ocean is vast, beautiful, and unforgiving — and it’s time to prove that you are its true ruler.

releases.name: Grave Seasons
releases.summary:
Can't decide who to date, what school to go to, or what team to pick as a winner?

This application will help you to decide.  You simply create a group or groups and add members or items to each of the groups.  Random generator then eliminates members or items one by one and then generates a winner. 

The generator/eliminator can be run repeatedly for the same group and the results are statistically evaluated.  The results can be reset if desired.

releases.name: Back Driver Simulator
releases.summary:
Get ready for a wild ride in Back Driver Simulator, where you’re not behind the wheel - but your decisions still control the chaos. 

Sit in the back seat of a speeding taxi, direct the driver, and navigate unpredictable roads from a first-person perspective. Every choice matters, and one wrong command can turn a smooth run into total disaster.

Fast, absurd, and full of surprises, this is a driving experience unlike any other.

releases.name: Survival Legion
releases.summary:
Recruit Warriors. Build Your Legion. Survive Every Battle.

Lead a small group of survivors and build the ultimate legion in a world where every battle makes your army stronger. Defeat enemies, recruit new warriors, and expand your forces as you fight to become the strongest commander on the battlefield.

*Build Your Legion
Start with only a handful of fighters and grow into an unstoppable army. Recruit survivors after every victory, strengthen your squad, and unlock powerful new units to dominate the battlefield.
*Survive Intense Battles
Face relentless waves of enemies and dangerous rival legions. Every encounter requires quick decisions, smart movement, and tactical positioning. Only the strongest commanders will survive.
*Customize Your Fighters
Unlock a variety of skins and visual upgrades to create a unique-looking legion. Personalize your army and stand out while leading your warriors into battle.

Build your army, survive against overwhelming odds, and become the legendary commander of Survival Legion.

releases.name: Quarantine Wing: Horror
releases.summary:
Some places are abandoned for a reason.

When rumors spread about the sudden closure of a local Hospital, most people stayed away. Stories of strange noises, unexplained disappearances, and something lurking in the abandoned halls were dismissed as urban legends.

You don't believe any of it.

As an independent blogger searching for the truth, you enter the hospital with nothing but a camera and a flashlight, determined to uncover what really happened. But after stepping inside, the exits are sealed behind you.

The only way out... is through.

Features:
>Explore a large abandoned hospital filled with secrets.
>Solve puzzles to unlock new areas and find your escape.
>Experience tense survival horror with a focus on atmosphere.
>Survive terrifying encounters while finding your way to freedom.

releases.name: Small Saga
releases.summary: Beneath the streets of London, an angry mouse seeks revenge against the god who stole his tail. An epic RPG of miniature proportions!

releases.name: Handyman Flipper: House Stories
releases.summary:
From Broken Rooms to Dream Homes.

Become the neighborhood handyman and transform rundown houses into beautiful homes!
Take on renovation jobs, travel to different locations, and restore homes room by room. Clean up trash, replace damaged flooring, paint walls, install ceiling panels, and furnish interiors to satisfy your clients.
Complete contracts to earn money and invest in better tools and equipment. Upgrade your gear to work faster, take on bigger projects, and become the most trusted handyman in town.
Every house is a new challenge, and every renovation brings you one step closer to building your dream handyman business.

releases.name: Damways
releases.summary:
Get ready for a clever, relaxing, and strategy-filled adventure across a lake where every move matters. In Damways, you control a resourceful beaver that slides endlessly across the water, reshaping the environment with dams and creating unlikely paths toward home.

But nothing here is as simple as it seems. The beaver does not move step by step. Once it starts sliding, it only stops when it hits an obstacle, a wall, wood, or one of your own dams. This turns every direction into an important decision where predicting the trajectory matters just as much as choosing the destination.

Collect bundles of wood scattered around the lake and use them to build strategic dams capable of completely reshaping the map. Create new barriers, redirect routes, open impossible paths, and transform the environment piece by piece until the perfect solution appears.

Every piece of wood is precious. You can carry only one at a time, so deciding when to collect, where to build, and how to reorganize the lake makes all the difference. A badly placed dam can block your entire route… but with Undo and Restart features, there is always room to experiment with new ideas.

As the journey continues, the challenges become increasingly creative, bringing more complex maps, clever obstacles, and puzzles that demand observation, planning, and spatial reasoning. The result is a relaxing yet deeply satisfying experience for players who love well-crafted puzzles.

With cozy visuals, a peaceful atmosphere, and that wonderful feeling of finally understanding the solution, Damways transforms every lake into a strategic playground full of possibilities.

Observe the environment, slide through the water, and build the perfect path toward the den.

releases.name: Tiny Crown
releases.summary: Tiny Crown is a fast-paced pixel-art platformer where you guide a brave little king through a castle full of traps, spikes, and dangerous jumps. Run, leap, and survive your way across handcrafted levels that test your timing, precision, and patience. Don’t let the charming retro visuals fool you — every room is a challenge. One wrong move, and the castle will punish you. But with skill, persistence, and sharp reflexes, even the smallest ruler can conquer the deadliest dungeon.

releases.name: Street Food Simulator
releases.summary:
From Corner Cart to Culinary Kingpin!

You are not just the head chef, but also the manager, cashier, and driving force behind the city's most popular food truck. Bustling sidewalks are filled with hungry customers waiting for you to take their orders, prep the ingredients, and serve them mouthwatering meals that are hot, fresh, and served exactly on time.

Success in the street food business requires more than a great recipe. It demands lightning-fast reflexes and impeccable time management. During the daily lunch rush, you must multitask effortlessly with smooth, intuitive gamepad controls. Juggle multiple orders, keep a close eye on the grill, and ensure nothing burns! Each satisfied customer will leave you with hard-earned cash and a growing reputation. However, if you make them wait too long, they will walk away hungry.

Use your daily profits to transform your modest setup into a world-class culinary enterprise. As you progress, you will unlock a wide variety of new ingredients, allowing you to expand your menu and take on exciting new cooking challenges. Purchase top-tier kitchen equipment to speed up prep time and eventually unlock expanded dining spaces to accommodate larger crowds. Put on your apron, turn on the stove, and see how far you can take your street food empire!

Key Features:
• Sizzle & Serve: Master the daily rush! Cook, assemble, and deliver orders quickly before your hungry customers get impatient.
• Upgrade Your Kitchen: Use your hard-earned profits to invest in high-tech grills, faster fryers, and advanced prep stations to increase your efficiency.

releases.name: Choppa: Rescue Rivals
releases.summary: Take to the skies in Choppa: Rescue Rivals! Pilot daring rescue missions in a Saturday-morning-anime story mode packed with high-stakes action, colorful characters, and a globe-trotting adventure. Save lives, outfly rivals, and become a legendary ace pilot! Choppa: Rescue Rivals is a modern-but-retro reimagining of the arcade-style action games made famous by 1980s classics like Choplifter, with a touch of Nintendo mixed in. Like many, we share a deep nostalgia for the vibrant world of the ‘80s and ‘90s media: Arcade games, toys, cartoons and anime that defined our childhoods. Driven by this passion, we set out to create a game that brings those cherished memories to life. A Nostalgic "Saturday Morning Anime" Storyline Step into the cockpit with Rick, a legendary rescue chopper pilot coaxed out of retirement for one last, crucial mission on a disaster-ravaged oil rig. With his rescue pilot license freshly reinstated, Rick is thrust into an unexpected scuffle with Burdock, his former wingman turned adversary, uncovering a sinister plot led by the malevolent A.C.R corporation. As the stakes soar higher, Rick and his comrades from the Thunderbolt Rescue Foundation must outwit and outmaneuver their foes to thwart Burdock's dark ambitions. Dynamic Globetrotting Gameplay Choppa: Rescue Rivals offers a unique blend of chaotic gameplay, compelling storytelling, and cooperative rivalry. Prepare for an unforgettable ride to the skies where luck, strategy and skill will determine the true heroes. Gather your team and don't forget: It's time to GET TO THE CHOPPA!

releases.name: Nordic Storm Solitaire
releases.summary:
An ancient Nordic adventure awaits! Help Elof lead his people to a land promised by the God Feyr! Beware... this land is under dispute by the Jotun Idyl, an archrival of the ancient Gods.
Play through challenging levels as the story unveils through the cards you've been dealt.

releases.name: Shinkansen Card Pull Simulator
releases.summary:
This game features 50 unique cards showcasing real photographs of Tokaido and Sanyo Shinkansen bullet trains. 

From the cutting-edge N700S to the classic 0 Series that started it all, and even the legendary Doctor Yellow Type 923 T4 - retired in 2025 - build your ultimate Shinkansen collection.

releases.name: Lost to Time
releases.summary: Lost to Time is a time-pause focused 2D action platforming metroidvania game, with a carefully crafted world to explore in an non-traditional fantasy RPG fashion. In order to overcome insurmountable odds, Chrona must manipulate the flow of time in order to gain advantages over opponents.

releases.name: Plungeez
releases.summary:
Explore the underground labyrinth of a historic city’s sewers and uncover secrets in an interconnected world.

Plungeez is an exploration-focused puzzle-adventure that puts your mind to the test. Dive deep into a complex underground sewer system in the historic city of Salvador, Brazil, where progress isn’t measured by brute force, but by perception and logic.

Run, push, activate, and explore. Like a Metroidvania, Plungeez’s map is vast and full of hidden connections that require you to go back and forth to solve the central mysteries. With no combat distractions, you can fully focus on the mechanics of each puzzle and the unique atmosphere of this pixel-art world.

releases.name: Star Troopers - Combat Force
releases.summary:
Enter a high-speed combat arena where every second matters and every move decides your survival.

Set in a futuristic cyberpunk world, you fight as an elite operator inside advanced simulation arenas controlled by powerful corporations. Move constantly and use speed and positioning to stay in control during intense combat encounters.

Dash, jump, and react instantly while collecting resources and adapting to fast-changing combat situations. Each arena offers vertical gameplay, interactive elements, and multiple ways to approach every fight.

Fight, adapt, and stay one step ahead in a world built for combat.

releases.name: Cruise Adventure: Hidden Journey
releases.summary:
All aboard for the honeymoon of a lifetime!

The anchor's up, the horizon gleams, and your grand Pacific adventure has only just begun. In Cruise Adventure: Hidden Journey Collector's Edition, you and your new spouse step onto a breathtaking luxury liner -- and into a world of sun-drenched islands, dazzling parties, and secrets waiting to be uncovered at every port of call.

But the newlyweds aren't the only ones with a story to tell. Watch as a distinguished captain and a sharp-witted manager navigate their own unexpected connection -- because on this voyage, love has a way of finding everyone.

releases.name: Tiny Paw Academy - Numbers Fun
releases.summary:
Fun Learning for Preschoolers

Tiny Paws Academy: Numbers Fun is the perfect learning game for preschoolers! Featuring 15 charming mini games set in a world of adorable forest and farm animals, this is early education at its most playful.
Using your controller, children navigate a friendly on-screen cursor to count animals, compare groups, train their memory, recognise numbers and dice, and discover which animal is biggest or fastest — all brought to life with beautiful animations and delightful sounds.
Perfect to share on the couch or let your little one explore independently!

WHAT YOUR CHILD WILL LEARN
• Counting and number recognition
• Comparing groups and sizes
• Memory and observation skills
• Logical ordering and sequencing
• Species recognition and categorisation

15 MINI GAMES INCLUDE
• Did you see this animal?
• Which group is bigger?
• Find the fastest / biggest animal
• Count all animals and species
• Numbers and dice in the correct order
• Animals coming out of a magical hat
• Memory and much more!
